label: Selector Rule Registry — filtered subset matching pipeline/reference-patterns/library.json

structuralCheckDefinitions.MATRIX_HERO_SHAPE: every groupId that is a `from` of >=1 axis_membership relationship has >=3 elements.

disqualifierDefinitions.MATRIX_SINGLE_AXIS: fewer than 2 distinct axis_membership target elements exist
disqualifierDefinitions.MATRIX_NOT_HERO_SHAPE: MATRIX_HERO_SHAPE fails — RP-MATRIX-PLAIN-01 may be the better fit

structuralCheckDefinitions.MATRIX_PLAIN_SHAPE: every groupId that is a `from` of >=1 axis_membership relationship has <3 elements.

disqualifierDefinitions.MATRIX_SINGLE_AXIS: fewer than 2 distinct axis_membership target elements exist
disqualifierDefinitions.MATRIX_NOT_PLAIN_SHAPE: MATRIX_PLAIN_SHAPE fails — RP-MATRIX-HERO-01 may be the better fit

structuralCheckDefinitions.HIERARCHY_SINGLE_ROOT_WITH_2_CHILDREN: build a directed graph from `contains` relationships; exactly 1 node has in-degree=0 while being a `from` endpoint at all (the root); that root's out-degree is >=2.

disqualifierDefinitions.MULTIPLE_OR_AMBIGUOUS_ROOTS: more than 1 node qualifies as a root — defer rather than force this pattern

structuralCheckDefinitions.PMI_HAS_EMPHASIS_IN_SOME_GROUP: at least 1 element with emphasis=true exists among the groupIds that appear as a `from` or `to` endpoint of this slide's contains/sequence relationships.

disqualifierDefinitions.NO_PHASE_GROUPING: sequence relationships exist but no contains relationships pair with them — use the plain 'roadmap' template instead

KPI_COUNT_IN_RANGE.description: count of groupIds that are not a reserved container id ("insights"/"trendChart"/"trendChart-*") and have both a title and a value element — must be 3-5.

COMPARISON_SHAPE_VALID.description: the "criteria" group has >=minCriteria title elements; every non-reserved group (a candidate) has a title element and exactly as many value elements as there are criteria.

DECISION_COUNT_IN_RANGE.description: count of groupIds that are not a reserved container id ("recommendation"/"nextSteps") and have a number, a title, and >=1 bullets (action) element — must be 2-4.

TAKEAWAY_SHAPE_VALID.description: count of groupIds that are not a reserved id ("insightPanel"/"soWhat") or an insight-item prefix ("insightPanel-*") and have number+category+headline+body — must be 2-4. Additionally (unconditionally, not just for the canonical 3-takeaway count): >=1 "insightPanel-*" item group each with number+title+body, and a "soWhat" group with a body element.

MATRIX_BADGELIST_SHAPE.description: all 4 of the canonical quadrant groupIds ("top-left"/"top-right"/"bottom-left"/"bottom-right") must be present, each with a number + title element and >=1 item sub-group (groupId prefix "${position}-item-") that itself has a title element. Additionally (unconditionally): an "axisX" group and an "axisY" group, each with a title element and exactly 2 label elements (low, then high); and an "insights" group with >=1 bullets element (mandatory, not optional).

WORKSTREAM_100DAY_SHAPE.description: 3-5 groups with groupId prefix "workstream-", each with a title + icon element. Exactly 3 groups with prefix "phase-", each with a title + a unique order element (1/2/3). Exactly (workstream count x 3) groups with prefix "activity-", each with a title + icon + >=1 bullets + a workstreamRef + a phaseRef, covering every workstream x phase pair exactly once (100% coverage, no cross-assignment errors). Exactly 3 groups with prefix "milestone-", each with a label + title + a unique position element (1/2/3) + a phaseRef, one milestone per authored phase (1:1 mapping, not an independent count).
